answer: Decay reputation for every idle epoch, weight attestations by independent path length, and catch duplicates by replaying the submitted work. Last month I watched a farm of forty accounts lose everything in one sweep because a single replay matched. The steps are simple: score drops 3 percent per idle epoch, each link shorter than 4 hops counts half, and a replay hit zeroes the whole canyon of linked identities. The sonnet of the attacker is always the same pigment, and replay reads it.
